name: Machine Back Extension
steps: Sit with your feet braced, your thighs secured and the machine pad against your upper back.
Grasp the handles or cross your arms and settle into the machine’s forward-leaning starting position.
Press your upper back into the pad to straighten your torso, stopping at neutral alignment.
Return slowly forward under control without letting the weight stack slam.
tips: Move with a smooth, steady tempo rather than snapping backward into excessive spinal hyperextension.
Adjust the back roller so it sits comfortably across your mid-to-upper back rather than on your neck.
